$comment: HUD-1 'ledger family' icon code. One source for the UI (glyphs.tsx: the fallback ground of an item with no art), the icon grader (tools/imagegen/icon_grade.py) and the icon probe (_harness/icon_probe.mjs). An item's family is the Dial Bar ledger family (Strike, Craft, Guard, Stride) that carries most of its stat weight: sum weight × value per family, highest wins; an item with no stats takes the family of its first tag in `tags`; a tier listed in `tiers` (boots) always takes that family. `ground` = [centre, edge] of the painted ground the item sits on (centre lit behind the subject, edge dark), all four VALE's own and far apart (CIELAB hue 32, 305, 188, 82 degrees at L* 54 centre / 27 edge; none near the old navy). Abilities sit on the owning fighter's vfx.signature hue (monsters and other owners on `abilityNeutral`). Weights only rank a record's own stats against each other; they are not prices.
